model: Score ~ Normal(player baseline + course + skill×traits + tee-window weather + form, σ_player). Birdies/Bogeys/Pars ~ NegBin(same inputs). No player-course random effect.

traits.note: yardage=7322 scorecard; 2025 FW/GIR rates shrunk with k=8 events toward tour-course means; no player-course term

wave.structure: R1 is a single morning wave, tees 1 and 10, 8:45–10:46 JST. There is no AM/PM wave.
wave.wind_feature: mean sustained mph over the tee window (archive windMph, gusts not blended)
